title: clippy::type_complexity warning in jmap-jscontact-types tests (pre-existing)
description:
cargo clippy -p jmap-jscontact-types --all-targets -- -D warnings fails on:

crate-jmap-jscontact-types/src/lib.rs:1735:20
    let cases: &[(&str, serde_json::Value, fn(&AnniversaryDate) -> bool)] = &[

clippy::type_complexity wants this factored into a type alias. The fix is:

    type AnniversaryDateTestCase = (&'static str, serde_json::Value, fn(&AnniversaryDate) -> bool);
    let cases: &[AnniversaryDateTestCase] = &[ ... ];

Or add #[allow(clippy::type_complexity)] on the test fn.

Pre-existing on main as of a07804bf883d57ae0d2c3805f5e63c56fc3dfdc8; reproduced under clean checkout.

Trigger discovery: workspace clippy gate during JMAP-glx8 review-loop work in crate-jmap-contacts-types.
close_reason: Batch 11: committed and adversarially verified (or already fixed); CI green at cc87669d
